description: This PHP source file defines the ListCurrency class, which manages currency data and interfacing within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for currency lookup, updating, generating JavaScript for currency conversions, and rendering currency management tables.

classes.name: ListCurrency
classes.description: Class for managing currencies, including lookup, update, JavaScript generation, and table rendering in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: lookupCurrencies
methods.description: Loads active currencies into the class's list property.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding new currency entries, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating existing currencies, restricted to admin users.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code for currency conversion functions.

methods.name: getSelectOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML option tags for available currencies and initializes related JavaScript arrays.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Builds and returns an HTML table for currency management, including add/edit forms.

methods.name: setCurrencyFields
methods.description: Sets JavaScript variables for currency-related form fields.
